evidence: In 3d_top, 3d_iso and 3d_iso_back every visible body (SOIC-8, SOT-223, terminal blocks, header, passives) has clear board surface between it and its neighbors with no intersecting or stacked bodies.
Both iso views show all bodies seated flush on the PCB surface with no floating, sunken, or tilted components.

In 3d_top two bare two-pad footprints below D1 (R1/R2 per the 2D view) have no component bodies at all, so body-centered-on-pads cannot be confirmed for them; all other visible bodies are centered on their pads.

Screw terminals J1 (left edge) and J2 (right edge) open outward over the board edge, header J3 sits at the top-right edge, there are no relays, and the single polarized part D1 cannot be inconsistently oriented.
not applicable - no RF module or antenna keepout exists on this board.

The buck chain along the bottom reads as an ordered row, but the LDO cluster is scattered: C4 floats several mm above U2, C5/C6 are offset rather than grid-aligned with U2, and long ratsnest lines fan out to J3, so the group does not read as a tight aligned cluster.
